package rulefixtures

import (
	"strings"
)

// scenario for strings_newreplacer_per_call: `strings.NewReplacer(...)` recreated on request or loop paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario660Positive(items []string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, item := range items {
		r := strings.NewReplacer("a", "b", "c", "d")
		b.WriteString(r.Replace(item))
	}
	return b.String()
}
